notes.title: Version 9 - Trailer & Launch Preview
notes.notes:
[b]Version 9 - Trailer & Launch Preview[/b]

We are excited to announce the release of Version 9 for "Subject 95"! This update includes the following:

[b]Trailer & Launch Preview:[/b]
Get an exclusive first look at the official trailer for "Subject 95". The trailer showcases key gameplay elements, characters, and the immersive world of our game. Watch now to see what’s in store!

[b]New Features & Enhancements:[/b]
- [b]Enhanced Graphics:[/b] Improved visual fidelity and performance optimizations.
- [b]New Levels:[/b] Explore new environments and face fresh challenges.
- [b]Character Updates:[/b] Meet new characters and discover more about Subject 95's story.
- [b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b] Refined mechanics for smoother and more engaging gameplay.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Addressed various bugs and glitches reported in previous versions.
- Enhanced stability and performance across different hardware configurations.

[b]Community Feedback:[/b]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Your input is invaluable in helping us improve "Subject 95". We look forward to hearing your thoughts on Version 9!

Join the discussion below and let us know what you think about the new trailer and the updates in this release. Stay tuned for more exciting news as we approach the official launch!

notes.title: 2023 Major Update - Subject 95 - V9.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

I hope everyone is having an amazing 2023 so far! It's been a little under a year since Subject 95 has released its last major update. Today, I'm thrilled to announce version 9.0, a game-changing update that will take Subject 95 to new heights! We have listened to your feedback and worked tirelessly to bring you a host of exciting features and improvements that will enhance your gaming experience. Let's dive right in and explore what's coming in this update.

[h2]More Levels and Gameplay[/h2]

Prepare yourselves for an adrenaline-pumping adventure with a plethora of new levels! We've been hard at work crafting unique challenges and mind-bending puzzles that will put your skills to the test. From intricate mazes to intense combat arenas, each level has been carefully designed to push you to your limits. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting your Subject 95 journey, these new levels will provide hours of exhilarating gameplay.

[h2]Graphics Overhaul[/h2]

Get ready to feast your eyes on stunning visuals! In version 9.0, we are introducing a complete graphics overhaul to Subject 95. The game's environments, characters, and special effects have all received a significant upgrade, resulting in a more immersive and visually captivating experience. Witness the game world come to life with enhanced textures, improved lighting, and realistic physics. Immerse yourself in the dystopian atmosphere like never before.

[h2]Better AI[/h2]

We have heard your feedback regarding the AI in Subject 95, and we've taken it to heart. In this update, we've implemented a robust AI system that will challenge even the most seasoned players. Enemies will now exhibit improved tactics, adapt to your playstyle, and provide a greater sense of challenge and unpredictability. Get ready for intense battles and thrilling encounters as you face off against the enhanced AI.

[h2]A Gripping Storyline[/h2]

Prepare to unravel the mysteries of Subject 95 through an immersive and gripping storyline. Version 9.0 introduces a rich narrative that will guide you through the dark and enigmatic world of the game. Delve into the secrets that lie within the facility and uncover the truth behind your existence as Subject 95. Engage with memorable characters, face moral dilemmas, and make choices that will shape the outcome of your journey. Get ready for a narrative experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[h2]Xbox and Microsoft Store Release[/h2]

We're incredibly excited to announce that Subject 95 will be making its way to Xbox and the Microsoft Store! Now, Xbox players and PC users can embark on this thrilling adventure together. Experience the intense action, unravel the mysteries, and compete for the top spot on the leaderboards. We can't wait to see how the Subject 95 community grows and thrives on these platforms!

[h2]Important Announcement: Multiplayer Servers Closure[/h2]

With great excitement also comes some bittersweet news. We want to inform you that, after careful consideration, we have made the difficult decision to close the multiplayer servers for Subject 95's beta builds. While we understand the disappointment this may cause for some players, this decision will enable us to focus our resources on delivering the best possible single-player experience and ensure a smoother and more polished gameplay experience overall.

The closure of the multiplayer servers will take place on the 1st of August 2023. We encourage all beta players to take this opportunity to enjoy the multiplayer experience until then and make lasting memories with friends and fellow Subject 95 enthusiasts.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Version 9.0 of Subject 95 is poised to be a monumental update that will redefine your gaming experience. With more levels, a graphics overhaul, improved AI, and a gripping storyline, there's never been a better time to dive into the dystopian world of Subject 95. We are thrilled to bring Subject 95 to Xbox and the Microsoft Store, opening up new horizons for the game and its community.

As always, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated player base for their continuous support and feedback. Your passion for Subject 95 inspires us to create the best possible gaming experience. We can't wait for you to join us on this thrilling journey and discover what awaits in the depths of Subject 95's dark and enigmatic world.

Stay tuned for more updates, and remember, your survival depends on your wits, determination, and the choices you make. The countdown to version 9.0 has begun!

notes.title: Update 8.0 - The Graphics & Mechanics Overhaul
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! With our Halloween Update approaching soon, I've decided to overhaul the graphics once again, you'll also find new mechanics to play around in. Multiplayer is officially scrapped because we believe it does not fit the nature of our game. Join our discord to become a beta tester! Happy Playing!

We are looking for volunteer voice actors, please email cyproductionsgames@gmail.com

Our next part of Subject 95 is an in-depth campaign so we are looking for voice actors so please apply in the email above!

notes.title: 2022 Updates & Roadmaps + v6.1 Release
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! Here at Cy Productions, we hope you have a great 2022 and we also hope to keep on playing Subject 95. We will describe how we plan to take the game further in 2022 and our 6.1 update. Firstly, we'll talk about the 6.1 update. It is the 6th Rewrite & Final Re-write of Subject 95. It has a total mechanics overhaul, we have graphic settings and a pause menu.

In 2022, we plan to release many more levels and add NPC's using OpenAI. We also plan to release some DLC's, multiplayer and Virtual Reality Support. Below list of the current roadmap

2022:

January: Version 6.6
February: Hopefully adding 5 New Levels
March: We plan to add a DLC
July: We are going to work on a VR System
September: Version 7 will have multiplayer and an in app purchase scheme.
December: The roll out of the Level Editor!

notes.title: Version 5 Released!
notes.notes: In this update, we added achievements for completing levels, we made the levels longer and added more puzzles to levels that aren't just platforming. We also totally redone the graphics.

notes.title: VR, Multiplayer and Level Editor Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Subject 95 has been around for a while now, since November 2018, although its only recently open to download. Today marks the day when the development of VR, Multiplayer and Level Editor starts. It is open to Subject API Testers. Stay tuned for more information about this major update.

Peace!
